page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 64 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage options for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. Additionally, the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated core allocation and 3.1 GHz clock speed offer predictable compute performance for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance class suitable for general-purpose workloads, medium-sized databases, web serving, and enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated physical cores without the resource sharing of hyperthreading.
